title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 1: Ahaziah's fall and sickness, his inquiry of Baal Zebub, and Elijah and the captains of fifty.

questions.text: Who rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens by saying that Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

answers.text: Edom
Moab
Syria
Ammon

questions.explanation: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room in Samaria, and was sick.

answers.text: He was wounded by an arrow in battle
He was thrown from his chariot
He ate poisoned food at a feast
He fell through the lattice in his upper room

questions.text: Whom did Ahaziah send messengers to inquire of about his recovery?
questions.explanation: Ahaziah told his messengers to go and inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether he would recover.

answers.text: Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron
Dagon, the god of Ashdod
Elijah the Tishbite
The prophets of Samaria

questions.text: Who told Elijah to go up and meet the king's messengers?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, 'Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria.'

answers.text: Elisha his servant
A captain of fifty
Yahweh's angel
The king of Samaria

questions.text: How did the messengers describe the man who met them?
questions.explanation: They said he was a hairy man, wearing a leather belt around his waist, and the king said, 'It's Elijah the Tishbite.'

answers.text: An old man leaning on a staff
A young man dressed in white linen
A hairy man with a leather belt around his waist
A man wearing a mantle of purple

questions.text: Where was Elijah sitting when the first captain of fifty came to him?
questions.explanation: The captain went up to Elijah, and he was sitting on the top of the hill.

answers.text: On the top of the hill
Under a tree by the road
In the gate of Samaria
On the bank of the Jordan

questions.text: What happened to the first captain and his fifty men?
questions.explanation: Elijah said, 'If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky,' and fire came down and consumed him and his fifty.

answers.text: The earth opened and swallowed them
Fire came down from the sky and consumed them
They were struck with blindness
They fled back to the king in fear

questions.text: What did the third captain of fifty do when he came to Elijah?
questions.explanation: The third captain fell on his knees before Elijah and begged him to let his life and the life of his fifty men be precious in his sight.

answers.text: He ordered him to come down quickly
He drew his sword against him
He waited at the foot of the hill
He fell on his knees and begged for his life

questions.text: What did Yahweh's angel tell Elijah about the third captain?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's angel said to Elijah, 'Go down with him. Don't be afraid of him,' and Elijah went down with him to the king.

answers.text: Stay on the hill until he leaves.
Go down with him. Don't be afraid of him.
Call down fire on him as well.
Send him back to the king alone.

questions.text: Who began to reign in Ahaziah's place after he died?
questions.explanation: Ahaziah died according to Yahweh's word, and Jehoram began to reign in his place, because he had no son.

answers.text: Jehu
Joash
Jehoshaphat
Jehoram
